propositions: rebar comment accepts flag-like tokens (--body-file, --body) as positional body content instead of rejecting them, storing the flag string itself and silently discarding the intended body while exiting 0

positional-body commands (comment, create, edit, session-log, tag, untag, archive, set-verify-commands) lack validation to reject arguments beginning with dash, enabling silent loss of user content with zero error signal
the documented escape hatch (--) must enable users to intentionally store bodies that legitimately start with dash, and this must be tested across comment and tag commands
a guard mechanism driven by a command table specifying arity and Usage lines must prevent new positional-only commands from accidentally inheriting the same footgun
the implementation must refuse to store or silently truncate any body argument that appears flag-like, failing loud with non-zero exit and a message naming the correct form
